short_description: ConvexAdam with MIND-SSC features, the authors' code at a pinned commit with its defaults: the ImagingBenchmarks baseline convexadam_mind.
description:
Siebert et al.'s ConvexAdam: a coupled-convex initialisation on a coarse grid, then Adam instance optimisation on a finer one, both on MIND-SSC features. This app runs the authors' repository at commit b229e52 with convex_adam_pt(fixed, moving) and every setting at its default, exactly as the ImagingBenchmarks leaderboards run it. The pair must be aligned (rigidly for one patient, by an affine transform between two subjects): only the deformable stage runs. A GPU is needed. Output: the displacement field on the fixed grid, in mm along the world axes (ITK, LPS): the fixed point x matches x + u(x) in the moving image.

How to cite:
H. Siebert, L. Hansen, M. P. Heinrich, Fast 3D registration with accurate optimisation and little learning for Learn2Reg 2021, MICCAI Workshops 2021.
